reconstruction_summary: Reproduced V1 (KS with per-segment straight-line gyro-bias subtraction) — agent's declared favourite — by reimplementing the exact triage.v1_ks_recalibrated formula (yaw = v/L * tan(delta_road) minus per-segment mean KS residual on |delta_road|<0.01 samples) with platform-specific L from parameters.py.
notes: V1 is parameter-free apart from wheelbase L (2.984 m Mach-E, 3.700 m F-150 Lightning) and a per-segment scalar bias estimated on straight-line samples; no global fitted coefficients to load. Agent originally evaluated on Mach-E only (315 segments); canonical pool extends to F-150 Lightning (230 more), but V1's bias is local per segment so the model transfers cleanly.
